flow_cancellation_ordering.finalization: FlowCancelled commits only after every frozen target has exact closed launch attempts and released resources. Public RunningStreamGraph.cancel remains unchanged.
flow_cancellation_ordering.rule: A generic UI or Flow cancellation becomes DAG CANCEL only when the authoritative server cancellation path persists or joins the canonical CANCEL control under Graph UPDATE before worker/process termination.
flow_cancellation_ordering.runtime: A local TerminationSignal does not fabricate cancellation. The Flow registry joins an existing STOPPING/CANCEL journal; without one it follows the stable fail-closed FAIL path.
